notes.title: Into the Forgotten — FIRE: The First Dreamer joins Endix Expo
notes.content:

This atmospheric post-collapse adventure invites you to reconnect with the sacred and the forgotten. In the days ahead, we’ll be revealing more about the game’s themes, art style, and the world behind the flames.
